subject: E1.5 D1-lite: nested package statement in _lower_block (v1-shape)
description: Handle statement-form `package X;` nested in blocks/subs by transplanting v1's mechanism: Environment push scoped to remainder of enclosing block (recursive _lower_block handler), emit (p-set-current-package ...) inline + restore at block end, register pkg for pre-declare. Covers reset.t/bless.t/magic.t/local.t + Carp/Sub::Uplevel `package DB;` idiom.
